title: ModelProfile
description: Capability profile referenced by an AgentManifest (never a concrete model name). Bound to concrete provider/model pairs by a ModelPolicyBundle, versioned in Git, not in code.

modality.description: MDL-011: what this model actually is. Required, and required on purpose — the failure this prevents is a bundle that names an embeddings model in a chat profile, and a bundle that says nothing about a model cannot be checked against anything. The four values are the Prometheus catalog's own vocabulary (see contratos/gateway-prometheus/modalidades.md), adopted rather than translated: a private enum would need a mapping, and that mapping is not one to one — text AND vision are both served on /v1/chat/completions, so a chat profile accepts either. Aeon verifies the declaration, not reality: an embeddings model declared as text is still routed. Checking against the provider's live catalog is a separate feature.

priority.description: Lower = tried first; drives fallback cascade.

inference_class.description: MDL-008: where this model actually runs. Required, and default-deny: a candidate declaring local may only be served by prometheus_inference — the platform rule is that all local inference resolves in Prometheus — unless local_inference names its provider as an exception for a named environment. Undeclared is denied, not assumed: if it were default-allow with a deny rule on top, 'we enforce this as policy' would quietly degrade into 'we intended to'.

cost_per_million_input_tokens.description: OBS-003 FinOps: real USD rate per 1M input/prompt tokens. Only meaningful when cost_model=token_based; list pricing is a starting point, confirm against your actual provider contract.

cost_per_million_output_tokens.description: OBS-003 FinOps: real USD rate per 1M output/completion tokens. Only meaningful when cost_model=token_based.

local_inference.description: MDL-008's nominal exception. prometheus_inference is always allowed to serve inference_class=local; any other provider must be named here, together with the environment the exception belongs to, so that 'why was this allowed' is answerable from the file itself. It lives in the bundle, and therefore in Git under review, rather than in an environment variable nobody diffs.

environment.description: The declared environment this exception belongs to, e.g. dev-laptop. Recorded in the denial/authorisation message.

allowed_providers.description: Providers other than prometheus_inference permitted to serve local inference in this environment.

data_sensitivity.description: restricted routes only to candidates whose provider is listed in in_network_providers, and fails closed when none is. Which providers those are is a fact about a deployment, so it is declared here rather than known by the harness (MDL-017).

in_network_providers.description: MDL-017: the providers whose traffic never leaves the network, for this profile. Deliberately not the same list as local_inference.providers — a self-hosted model in a private VPC is in-network without being local inference.
